Heavy spine for breaking through fish bones

nameJa: 藤次郎 白紙鋼 出刃 165mm

The Shirogami #2 white steel is the traditional choice for deba, offering excellent toughness and easy sharpening. For home cooks who want to learn whole-fish preparation, this is the most cost-effective entry point.
descriptionJa: 藤次郎の白紙鋼出刃はプロの魚おろし性能を手頃な価格で提供。白紙2号鋼は出刃の伝統的な選択で、優れた靭性と容易な研ぎを両立。丸魚の処理を学びたい家庭料理人にとって最もコスパの良い入門品。

nameJa: 藤次郎 DPコバルト合金鋼 ペティ 150mm

The same VG-10 cobalt alloy construction as the legendary DP gyuto ensures excellent performance. Every kitchen needs a good petty, and this is the best value option.
descriptionJa: 藤次郎のペティは完璧なサブナイフ。150mmで牛刀には大きすぎる細かい作業 — 皮むき、トリミング、精密なカットに対応。伝説的なDPシリーズと同じVG-10コバルト合金で優れた性能を保証。良いペティはどのキッチンにも必要で、これが最高のコスパ。

nameJa: 高村 R2 ペティ 130mm
description: The Takamura R2 Petty is a scalpel for the kitchen. At only 55g with SG2 powdered steel at 63 HRC, it is one of the sharpest and lightest petty knives ever made. Perfect for brunoise, delicate herb work, and precision tasks. Paired with the Takamura R2 Gyuto, they form the ultimate two-knife set.
descriptionJa: 高村R2ペティはキッチンのメス。わずか55gのSG2粉末鋼63 HRCで、史上最も鋭く軽いペティナイフの一つ。ブリュノワーズ、繊細なハーブ作業、精密な作業に最適。高村R2牛刀と組み合わせれば究極の2本セット。

name: Misono UX10 Sujihiki 270mm
nameJa: ミソノ UX10 筋引 270mm
description: The Misono UX10 Sujihiki is the Japanese answer to the Western carving knife. Its long, narrow blade makes single-stroke slicing of roasts, hams, and large proteins effortless. The double-bevel grind makes it easier to use than a single-bevel yanagiba while achieving similar precision. Essential for any serious home cook who entertains.
descriptionJa: ミソノUX10の筋引は西洋のカービングナイフに対する日本の回答。長く細い刃がローストやハム、大きなタンパク質のワンストロークスライスを容易に。両刃研ぎで片刃の柳刃より使いやすく同等の精度を実現。おもてなしをする本格派料理人に必須。

nameJa: 杉本 CM鋼 牛刀 210mm
description: The Sugimoto CM Gyuto is the workhorse of Tokyo's Chinese restaurant kitchens. Built to withstand the demands of high-volume professional cooking, its Shirogami #1 steel takes a wicked edge while the slightly thicker grind provides durability. This is not a delicate knife — it is a reliable tool that gets the job done shift after shift.
descriptionJa: 杉本CM牛刀は東京の中華料理店の主力。大量調理の要求に耐える造りで、白紙1号鋼は驚異の刃付けを実現しつつ、やや厚めの刃付けが耐久性を提供。繊細な包丁ではない — シフトごとに確実に仕事をこなす信頼のツール。

name: Sakai Takayuki Aogami #2 Kiritsuke 270mm
nameJa: 堺孝行 青紙2号 切付 270mm
description: The Kiritsuke is traditionally reserved for the head chef (Itamae) in a Japanese kitchen — it is both a status symbol and a versatile tool. This Sakai Takayuki version uses Aogami #2 carbon steel with a k-tip (sword-tip) profile that handles both the work of a yanagiba and an usuba. Single-bevel and demanding to use, but supremely rewarding.
descriptionJa: 切付は伝統的に日本の厨房で板前（料理長）のみに許される — ステータスシンボルであり万能のツール。堺孝行版は青紙2号カーボンスチールにK-tip（剣先）プロファイルで、柳刃と薄刃の仕事を一本でこなす。片刃で扱いは難しいが、極めて報われる。

featuresJa: 白紙2号カーボンスチール

nameJa: 旬 Classic 三徳 175mm
description: The Shun Classic Santoku is the quintessential Japanese home knife for Western kitchens. The 175mm santoku blade with a VG-MAX core surrounded by 16 layers of Damascus cladding creates a knife that excels at the three cutting methods: slicing, dicing, and mincing. The wide blade also doubles as a scoop for transferring chopped ingredients.

description: The Miyabi Birchwood SG2 is where German engineering meets Japanese blade craft. Produced by Zwilling J.A. Henckels in Seki, it features an SG2 micro-carbide steel core at 63 HRC wrapped in 100 layers of flower-pattern Damascus. The stunning birchwood handle with a mosaic pin is as much a display piece as it is a cutting tool. One of the most beautiful production knives ever made.

name: Tojiro Honesuki 150mm
nameJa: 藤次郎 骨スキ 150mm
description: The Tojiro Honesuki is an essential poultry knife that makes breaking down chickens a breeze. The stiff, triangular blade is designed to navigate around joints and separate meat from bone with surgical precision. VG-10 steel holds up to the demands of butchery work. At this price, it is the most accessible way to add a honesuki to your collection.

The VG-MAX steel serrations are far sharper than Western bread knives, cutting through crusty sourdough without crushing the crumb. The tsuchime (hammered) Damascus finish and walnut-colored pakkawood handle make it as beautiful as any knife in the Premier line. Proof that even a bread knife deserves to be special.

The SG2 powdered steel core at 63 HRC delivers exceptional edge retention, while the signature Senko (Flash) rain-drop Damascus pattern is instantly recognizable. The k-tip bunka shape excels at precise tip work while the wider blade handles everyday chopping. The luxurious urushi-lacquered handle is the finishing touch on a masterpiece.
